review.notes: Swapped the hearing_75_4 quote for the court's actual conclusion sentence at para 23 ('no violation of principles of natural justice much less any violation of... sub-section (4) of Section 75') -- the draft's quote only recited the undisputed facts leading up to it. Dated the hearing_missed event 2021-08-31 (the hearing date already established in notices[0].hearing_date) instead of leaving it null. Note: the judgment's own para 21 places the s.74 personal-hearing date (31.08.2021) before the s.74 SCN/DRC-01 date (24.05.2022) -- an apparent internal inconsistency in the judgment itself (31.08.2021 is also the date of an earlier DGGI summons, para 4); kept as stated since it is the court's own text and we don't correct the court. Companion case CWJC 2806/2023 (same order, different FY) is not this record; this is the lead petition (CWJC 1898/2023) argued in full. Two defects (hearing_75_4, other_procedural/parallel-proceeding) both correctly rejected on the merits; in scope.
